_doc: Windows workstation pilot for the five Ollama models prepared by scripts/setup_windows.ps1. It intentionally contains only local LLMs; use configs/grid_all_systems.json for the canonical comparative benchmark.
_llm_settings_note: Inductive one-row requests, one local request at a time, label metrics only, and zero tolerance for parser fallbacks. This is a functional pilot, not the publication roster.
